Knowledge Artifact Metadata
Name (machine-readable) TrustDemoIND02
Title (human-readable) TD.IND.02 Shared-link openings that were authorised
Status Draft
Experimental true
Description

Of the requests to open a family member's shared link, the proportion the home country released.
Measure Steward litlfred
Steward Contact Details litlfred: https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo
Measure Metadata
Version Number 0.1.0
Measure Scoring Proportion
Guidance

A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: TD.J41.DE01 Requested at; TD.J41.DE02 Requester; TD.J41.DE06 Released; TD.J41.DE08 Refusal reason. Decision tables: TD.DT.05. Requirements: STD-ACC-001. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.
Measure Population Criteria
Denominator Description:

Manifest requests in the reporting period, released or refused.
Numerator Description:

Manifest requests in the reporting period that were released.
Stratifier Code: Refusal reason
Description: wrong-passcode, expired, withdrawn (TD.DT.05)
Stratifier Code: Requesting system
Description: the receiver abroad, and its country
